T: Stuck at JFK, nine months and counting.
D: A traveller from Krakozhia is stranded at JFK when his country falls to a coup mid-flight, and makes a life inside the terminal.
P: Serve the cheesecake when Viktor collects Benny Golson's autograph.
S: Viktor's cracker sandwiches with hot mustard
Saltine crackers sandwiched with hot mustard, the cheapest lunch in the terminal.

Beat the mustard into the soft butter. Spread half the crackers with the mustard butter and top with cheddar and cornichon. Close with the remaining crackers, pressing so the mustard just squeezes through the holes, and scatter with chives.
Potato dumplings with butter and sour cream. A coup in Krakozhia mid-flight.

Mix the flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt to a soft dough and rest it 15 minutes. Mix the mash with the cheddar and half the onion, fried soft, and season well. Roll the dough thin, cut 8cm rounds, fill and pinch shut. Boil the dumplings until they float, then fry in the butter with the rest of the onion until golden. Serve with sour cream and dill.
M: Thin griddled cheeseburgers with pickles, paid for in luggage cart quarters.

Shape the mince into 4 thin patties a little wider than the buns and season well. Grill over high heat 3 minutes, flip, add the cheese and cook 2 minutes more. Toast the buns and spread with mayo and tomato sauce. Build with lettuce, tomato, the patty, pickles and onion.
Enrique's catering truck chicken and rice
Paprika chicken and rice. Enrique trades meals for help with Dolores.

Rub the chicken with the paprika, garlic, lemon, oil and salt. Roast skin-side up at 210C until crisp and cooked through. While it roasts, soften the onion, stir in the rice and saffron, add the stock and simmer, covered, until tender. Steam the beans for the last 5 minutes and serve everything together, airline tray style.
8 chicken thighs, bone in, skin on@Meat
W: Great Day in Harlem New York cheesecake
Baked cheesecake with a buttery graham crust, dense, creamy and very New York.

Mix the crumbs and butter and press into a lined 22cm springform tin. Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs, sour cream, vanilla and zest. Pour over the base and bake at 150C until just set with a wobble in the middle, then cool in the turned-off oven. Simmer the cherry juice with the cornflour until glossy, stir in the cherries and spoon over the chilled cake.
680g jar pitted sour cherries, drained, 125ml juice kept@Pantry
K: Iced coffee with condensed milk. For Dolores, a stallion.
Spoon the condensed milk into 4 tall glasses and fill with ice. Pour over the iced coffee, then the milk, and dust with cinnamon. Stir at the table.
